what: NiSource is a regulated utility serving about 3.8 million customers across six states. Its largest businesses are Columbia Gas distribution and NIPSCO, which supplies electricity and gas in northern Indiana.
customers: Households, businesses and industry across Indiana, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Kentucky and Maryland.
money: Columbia Gas utilities across six states
NIPSCO electricity generation and delivery in Indiana
moat: Regulated monopolies in each territory, with returns set by state commissions and demand that holds up through economic cycles.
risks: Debt of about $18 billion against almost no cash
Replacing ageing gas pipe is a long and expensive obligation
Coal plant retirements in Indiana require replacement generation
Long-term decarbonisation policy is a risk to gas distribution
opportunities: Revenue grew about 23% last year with a 28% operating margin
Large data centre agreements in Indiana raise projected load growth sharply
Every approved investment adds to the base it earns a regulated return on
watch: Data centre load agreements in Indiana and rate case outcomes.
